evidence: The user asked for songs from a specific YouTube video title; web_search returned ~10 candidates with near-identical titles. The agent picked the first result (ovwwehTpaK8, a 'Helions Cover - Slap House' upload from Oct 2025 with 22 songs) without comparing the candidates or verifying it was the intended video. The agent never ran any diagnostic to disambiguate among the multiple same-titled videos and claimed done.
reasoning: No external service abruptly terminated the run unrecoverably — the transcript IP-block and the YouTube bot wall were transient and the agent worked around them successfully, so Service Failure doesn't fit. Nothing was silently stale: search returned current, correct results with multiple distinct video IDs, so Stale State Delivery doesn't fit. The root cause is the model encountering an ambiguous environment state (many videos sharing nearly the same title) and failing to investigate or disambiguate — it didn't compare candidates, inspect the lower-ranked hits, or pause to verify — which matches Recovery Failure.
